Science Videos

Watch, think and discover with primary science demonstrations and explanations.

🔎 Find science videos

Search for primary science demonstrations, explanations and revision clips. Choose a year and topic, then use trusted videos to deepen understanding.

Search Primary Science Videos ↗

🧠 Watch-and-think routine

  • Before: Predict what may happen.
  • During: Identify evidence and important observations.
  • After: Explain what you learned in your own words.

Teachers should preview videos for accuracy, age suitability, captions and access before sharing with pupils.

🧪

Science Lab

Ask questions, investigate safely, record observations and explain evidence.

🌧️ Rusting Investigation

Investigation question: What conditions are associated with rusting of iron?

Plan: Compare teacher-prepared setups fairly, observe visible changes over time and record evidence.

Safety: Follow school laboratory rules, do not taste materials and wash hands after the activity. Activities should be teacher-supervised.

Observe · Record · Explain

🏆

UASA Practice

Build confidence one question at a time with purposeful revision habits.

📝 Answering strategy

  1. Read the question carefully.
  2. Identify keywords and what is being asked.
  3. Study diagrams, tables and graphs before answering.
  4. Use accurate scientific terms.
  5. Check the answer against evidence.

📅 Revision routine

Review notes, answer questions without looking, correct mistakes and revisit challenging concepts.

Use teacher-created practice questions and label them clearly as revision materials, not official examination papers.
